HISD Avatar

User avatar: an <img> with required alt, or an initials fallback on a brand-tonal background with --color-on-action text. Sizes sm / md / lg, circular (--radius-pill), with an optional presence status dot that carries its own accessible name. The same markup is shown in light and dark themes below.

Light theme

Image variant — sizes sm / md / lg

Initials fallback — sizes sm / md / lg

AR AR AR

With presence status dot

ML

Interactive (keyboard-focusable button)

Tab to focus, Enter or Space to activate.

Dark theme

Image variant — sizes sm / md / lg

Initials fallback — sizes sm / md / lg

AR AR AR

With presence status dot

ML

Interactive (keyboard-focusable button)

Tab to focus, Enter or Space to activate.

Copy-paste snippet

<!-- Image avatar (required alt) -->
<span class="hisd-avatar hisd-avatar--md">
  <span class="hisd-avatar__media">
    <img class="hisd-avatar__img" src="/users/ana.jpg" alt="Photo of Ana Reyes">
  </span>
</span>

<!-- Initials fallback (no photo) -->
<span class="hisd-avatar hisd-avatar--md">
  <span class="hisd-avatar__media">
    <span class="hisd-avatar__initials" role="img" aria-label="Ana Reyes">AR</span>
  </span>
</span>

<!-- With presence status dot (success / muted).
     Static dot: role="img" + aria-label names it without a live region. -->
<span class="hisd-avatar hisd-avatar--md">
  <span class="hisd-avatar__media">
    <span class="hisd-avatar__initials" role="img" aria-label="Marcus Lee">ML</span>
  </span>
  <span class="hisd-avatar__status hisd-avatar__status--success" role="img" aria-label="Online"></span>
</span>

<!-- Interactive (button wrapper): icon-only, so it needs aria-label.
     Fold presence into the button's accessible name; keep the dot aria-hidden.
     Native <button> gives Enter/Space activation for free. -->
<button type="button"
        class="hisd-avatar hisd-avatar--md hisd-avatar--interactive"
        aria-label="Open Ana Reyes profile menu — Online" aria-haspopup="menu">
  <span class="hisd-avatar__media">
    <span class="hisd-avatar__initials" role="img" aria-hidden="true">AR</span>
  </span>
  <span class="hisd-avatar__status hisd-avatar__status--success" aria-hidden="true"></span>
</button>
